title: VAG (Nuremberg) Train Pack
description: this ist a pack including the VAG DT3 for MTR4.
body:
VAG DT3/VAG DT2 Sound Resource Pack for MTR4

This resource pack adds custom sounds for the VAG DT3/VAG DT2 train included in MTR4.

Included sounds:

Door open / close
Motor sounds
Running loop
Additional train ambience

Included train:

VAG DT3
VAG DT2
Sound credits:

szandorthe13th
rekon
Team Pommes

The pack is designed for Minecraft Transit Railway 4 (MTR4) and aims to recreate the authentic sound experience of the Nürnberg DT3 subway train.

The pack includes the DT3 train with custom sound configuration and audio enhancements.



Original R-Net pack and Metrokolej GMZ by Szandorthe13th and Rekon (Sounds without Doorclose): https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/rnet-stadler-flirt-3  /          https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/metrokolej-gzm
Original DT1 pack (DT2 Base): https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/nuremberg-trains

Original Door close sound Pack by Team Pommes:https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/nuremberg-trains



Again Credits:       TeamPommes    Szandorthe13th        Rekon
